Cinematography and camera operation form the backbone of my creative career, starting with my Film & Video Communication postgraduate diploma at MIT Institute of Design (2015–2018), where I studied camera techniques, cinematography, editing, sound engineering and post-production while completing more than 42 film projects. Professionally, I worked as Assistant Director and Video Producer at Filmalaya Studio, Natak Entertainment, The Glitch Media and Elcom International in Mumbai (2016–2018), then as Video Producer and Photographer at Klangpol in Germany (2020–2021), and in multiple video producer roles at Byju's (2018–2021) and SAP (from 2023). Across these roles I designed lighting setups, operated cameras in studio and on location, and ensured visual consistency for short films, documentaries, music videos, corporate videos, TV commercials and live events, often under tight deadlines and complex production conditions.

skill_chunks.skill: Green screen, VFX compositing and motion design
skill_chunks.evidence: Green screen, VFX and compositing have consistently featured in my portfolio since film school and early Mumbai studio work, and are highlighted in multiple cover letters delivering motion graphics, green screen and VFX-heavy content for TV commercials, digital advertisements and corporate videos. I used Adobe After Effects and related tools to key green screen footage, add motion graphics overlays, track elements and integrate animated assets. At SAP Services Sales MEE (August 2023–June 2024), I produced campaign videos using green screen technology and motion graphics for demand generation initiatives. At Byju's, I blended animated game elements and educational visuals into live action or voiceover-driven sequences. These projects required tight collaboration with creative directors and marketing teams to match brand guidelines and deliver high production value across web and social platforms.

skill_chunks.skill: Audio engineering and sound design for video
skill_chunks.evidence: Audio engineering and sound design are documented throughout my CV history, starting with formal study at MIT Institute of Design (2015–2018), where sound engineering and post-production of audio and video were core curriculum components across 42+ production projects. Professionally, I listed Adobe Auditions as a primary audio tool alongside Premiere Pro and After Effects in my early Video Producer CVs (2016–2021). At SAP IX Studio (October 2024–Present), I oversee audio engineering workflows for up to 12 microphones simultaneously, ensuring crystal-clear sound for both in-person and virtual participants during hybrid events. My audio experience covers multi-track mixing, voiceover recording, sound design for film and advertising, music synchronization, and broadcast-quality live sound management for corporate and artistic events.

skill_chunks.skill: 3D modeling and product visualization for campaigns
skill_chunks.evidence: 3D modeling and product visualization appear in my Digital Asset Manager role at Orange Sellers in Utrecht (April 2021–October 2021), where I created eye-catching 2D and 3D visual content including 3D models for Amazon marketplace brands to boost brand visibility and product sales. I used tools such as Blender and Adobe Substance 3D to build product models, apply materials and render stills or animations showcasing product features and aesthetics for advertising campaigns. These assets were combined with photography and motion graphics in cross-platform campaigns for FMCG, fashion and consumer goods brands. While 3D is not my primary specialization, this experience demonstrates my ability to work across 2D and 3D pipelines and integrate rendered visuals into broader video and social media strategies.

skill_chunks.skill: Assistant direction and line production for film
skill_chunks.evidence: Assistant direction and line production are emphasized in my early Mumbai-based roles at Filmalaya Studio (Assistant Director, July 2016–March 2017) and Natak Entertainment (Assistant Director, August 2017–February 2018), as well as in multiple cover letters describing my experience as Executive Producer, Line Producer and Assistant Director in TV and movie projects. In these positions I managed schedules, coordinated departments, prepared call sheets, handled extras and talent logistics, and ensured on-set continuity for feature films and high-end commercials. I frequently worked with crews ranging from 10 to 100 members, liaising between directors, cinematographers, production managers and post-production teams. This background gave me deep understanding of narrative construction, set discipline and the operational realities of large film productions, which later informed my structured project management in corporate media.

skill_chunks.skill: Vlogging and personal YouTube / Instagram brand content
skill_chunks.evidence: Vlogging and personal brand content strategy have been ongoing side projects where I independently ideate, produce and distribute videos about my city on YouTube and Instagram. Across several cover letters I mention running a YouTube channel with approximately 3,000 subscribers, experimenting with current trends, SEO and social media optimization to grow organic followers. This involves planning topics, writing scripts, shooting with available equipment, editing in Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, designing thumbnails and monitoring engagement metrics. I also create short-form content and stories for Instagram, aligning visual style with my professional identity as a video producer and designer. These efforts showcase creator economy workflow knowledge including audience development, platform algorithm awareness and cross-channel content repurposing.

skill_chunks.skill: Amazon Marketplace and FBA product media production
skill_chunks.evidence: Amazon Marketplace and FBA product media have been central to my work as Video Producer at Orange Sellers in Utrecht (internship April 2021–October 2021) and in subsequent freelance and application contexts. At Orange Sellers I managed multiple Amazon brands, producing 2D and 3D product visuals, videos, animations and 3D models to boost brand visibility and product sales, supported by targeted social media campaigns. In several cover letters I reference experience with Amazon FBA product shoots including ideation, scripting, lighting, shooting, editing and distributing cross-channel content for FMCG, fashion, food, jewelry and cosmetics. This domain experience covers listing-focused media assets, A+ content style visuals and campaign creatives aligned with Amazon marketplace best practices and performance goals.

skill_chunks.skill: Food, fashion, FMCG and lifestyle product shoots
skill_chunks.evidence: Food, jewelry, fashion, makeup and FMCG product shoots are a recurring theme throughout my video producer cover letters and CV entries from 2016 onward, including positions at The Glitch Media Pvt. Ltd., Elcom International Pvt. Ltd., Natak Entertainment, advertising agencies and as an independent producer (2011–2015). I have successfully attended and led shoots for these categories, producing print media flyers, banners, hoardings, editorial campaign content, TV commercials and cross-platform digital content for websites and social media. Responsibilities included pre-production planning, set and lighting design, directing models or product stylists, coordinating with makeup artists and agencies, and delivering polished outputs optimized for brand campaigns and digital advertising. This domain expertise demonstrates versatility across consumer-focused visual storytelling for both Indian and European markets.

skill_chunks.skill: EdTech and e-learning platform content (Byju's, Disney)
skill_chunks.evidence: EdTech and e-learning platform experience is anchored in my tenure at Byju's – The Learning App, a leading online learning platform in India, where I worked from June 2018 to March 2021 as Creative Associate and Designer. In my German motivation letter for Pinktum I describe transitioning from advertising to e-learning and participating in a Disney collaboration to produce an e-learning platform for audiences in the USA and UK. I crafted educational content, game elements and media assets that fit stringent pedagogical and brand requirements. This included adapting storytelling approaches for different age groups, managing production pipelines and aligning with international content standards. Combined with my earlier media and design studies and subsequent instructional roles, this EdTech experience gives credibility in large-scale, cross-market educational product development.

skill_chunks.skill: Music and cultural event media production
skill_chunks.evidence: Music and cultural event production is represented by my work with Klangpol – Netzwerk Neue Musik Nordwest in Oldenburg, Germany, where I served as Video Producer and Photographer for musical events between July 2020 and June 2021. In this role I captured concerts and performances, handled filming and photography under live conditions, and delivered edited videos and image sets that respected artistic integrity and event atmosphere. I coordinated with organizers, performers and technical staff to plan shots, manage low-light scenarios and ensure unobtrusive yet effective documentation. This experience complements my broader live event and broadcast work at SAP and demonstrates versatility in handling culturally oriented, performance-based projects as well as corporate or commercial content.

German language skills are consistently noted across my CVs as German B1 running, indicating ongoing formal learning alongside professional work in Germany from around 2019 onward. In applications to roles like Atlas Copco, Pinktum and German-speaking positions, I emphasize that I am fluent in English and learning German at B1 level, enabling me to communicate with diverse stakeholders and adapt to local workplace culture. While most of my professional output remains in English, this language progression supports day-to-day collaboration, understanding of German documentation, participation in bilingual meetings and communication with German-speaking colleagues and clients. It also complements my long-term intent to grow my career in German-speaking environments, particularly within SAP and other multinational companies based in Germany.

skill_chunks.skill: Live event production and hybrid event operations
skill_chunks.evidence: Live and hybrid event production is a major competency in my current SAP role as Live Streaming Engineer & Video Production Specialist at IX Studio, Transformation Advisory Center MEE (October 2024–Present). I manage 6–8 events weekly, handling studio bookings, confirmations and stakeholder communication while designing technical setups with 5-camera systems, audio for up to 12 microphones and a 12-foot LED wall. Work includes rehearsals, technical run-throughs, contingency planning and real-time troubleshooting for hybrid, offline and online formats. Previously, I produced live events and multi-camera broadcasts for corporate clients, musical events at Klangpol (2020–2021) and educational or marketing livestreams at SAP (2023–2024). These combined experiences give a robust understanding of run-of-show planning, technical direction and cross-departmental event coordination.

skill_chunks.skill: Digital asset management and governance workflows
skill_chunks.evidence: Digital asset management and governance feature prominently in my role as Digital Assets Curator and Communication Expert at SAP's Non-Commercial Licensing unit (June 2024–October 2024). I managed curation and non-commercial licensing checks for SAP communication projects, verifying assets against IP and usage guidelines, recording approvals and maintaining records to prevent misuse. I designed efficient workflows for digital asset storage, categorization and access, improving accessibility and collaboration among global teams. I also recreated reusable and editable templates and effects in DaVinci Resolve while enforcing branding consistency. This governance experience complements my creative background by ensuring that media usage remains legally compliant, well-organized and aligned with corporate standards across distributed international teams.

skill_chunks.skill: Team leadership for media crews of 10–100 members
skill_chunks.evidence: Team leadership for large media crews is highlighted in multiple video producer cover letters where I describe managing accomplished teams between 10 to 100 crew members across TV and movie projects, advertising campaigns and large-scale shoots in India before 2018. As Executive Producer, Line Producer, Assistant Director and Creative Associate, I coordinated directors, cinematographers, art departments, makeup artists, production assistants and post-production staff to deliver short films, feature films, music videos, TV commercials and corporate films on tight timelines. Responsibilities included scheduling, budget tracking, resource allocation, vendor coordination and on-set decision-making under pressure. These leadership experiences from 2011–2018 established my confidence in directing complex productions, which I later applied in corporate environments at Byju's and SAP for high-stakes events and communication projects.

skill_chunks.skill: Budget management and multi-project media coordination
skill_chunks.evidence: Budget management and multi-project coordination are emphasized in several video producer cover letters, where I describe managing shoot-related documents, budgets and simultaneous projects for advertising agencies and media companies in India and Europe. As Executive Producer, Line Producer and Assistant Director, I handled resource planning, vendor negotiations, cost tracking and scheduling for shoots covering feature films, commercials, music videos and corporate content. In later roles as Digital Asset Manager at Orange Sellers and Designer & Video Producer at SAP, I continued coordinating multiple campaigns, ensuring deadlines and quality standards were met across brands and stakeholders. These experiences established my ability to balance creative ambitions with financial constraints while maintaining clear documentation and communication across teams.

skill_chunks.skill: Brand campaign strategy and paid social advertising
skill_chunks.evidence: Brand campaign strategy and paid social advertising are referenced across multiple cover letters, where I describe extended experience in brand campaigns, promotions and paid advertising for platforms including Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, Twitter, YouTube and TikTok. I hold certificates in Advertising on Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, Twitter and YouTube, Integrated Marketing Strategies, Advanced Branding and Branding & Ideation for Marketers. At Orange Sellers I implemented social media strategies and campaigns for Amazon marketplace brands, driving product sales through targeted creative content. At Byju's and in freelance work, I created cross-platform content strategies for FMCG, fashion and consumer goods clients, coordinating production with platform-specific optimization, audience targeting and performance analysis to improve campaign reach and conversion.

skill_chunks.skill: Corporate internal communications and newsletter production
skill_chunks.evidence: Corporate communications and internal enablement content are central to my SAP roles. As Content and Communication Expert in Demand Management, Services Sales MEE (August 2023–June 2024), I created and maintained content for Services Sales initiatives across Middle and Eastern Europe, supporting demand generation. In Non-Commercial Licensing (June 2024–October 2024), I curated digital assets, designed templates and supported communication campaigns. At IX Studio I prepared newsletters, event materials and presentations for transformation advisory sessions. Across these roles I produced newsletters, presentations, banners, LinkedIn cards, website content and portal updates, consistently aligning messaging with SAP brand guidelines and stakeholder communication strategies to support internal alignment and partner engagement.

skill_chunks.skill: Computer Engineering background — UX/UI and software architecture
skill_chunks.evidence: My Bachelor's in Computer Engineering from Ganpat University (Gujarat, India, 2010–2013) provided foundational academic training in User Experience Design, User Interface Design, Data Visualisation, Programming and Software Architecture. Although my career pivoted toward media and design, this engineering background informs my understanding of system thinking, interface logic, front-end programming and the technical constraints of software development. It underpins my ability to collaborate effectively with developers, interpret technical requirements and contribute to SAP development environments. It also provides context for my transition into SAP BTP, ABAP and UI5 development during my earlier media and design studies.
